qismlar.sarlavha: Titul varag‘i va mundarija
Greeting. About Myself. “My name is…” with grammar focus TO BE (positive + negative)
My Address. Alphabet. Grammar: To be (Questions)
Professions. Grammar Focus: Present Simple (Positive Sentences)
Jobs. Grammar Focus: Present Simple (Negative)
I am a teacher. (Men o‘qituvchiman) Positive/Negative/Question forms of to be. Grammar Focus: Present Simple (Questions)
Numbers 1–20 Cardinal numbers. Grammar: Present Continuous (positive)
Numbers 21–50 Plural nouns (books, pens. Grammar: Present Continuous – Questions & Negatives
Numbers 51–100 How much?/ How many?
My family. (Mening oilam) Possessive adjectives (my, your, his, her, our, their). Grammar: Pronouns (subject & possessive)
Parents, brother, sister. (Ota-ona, aka-uka, opa-singil). Have/Has. Practice tests 1. Grammar: Possessive adjectives (my, your, his, her, our, their)
This is a chair. (Bu stul) Demonstratives (this, that, these, those). Grammar: Past Simple (regular & irregular verbs, affirmative/negative)
Tables and other furniture. There is/There are
Prices 1. (Narxlar) How much is it?/How much are they?
Prices 2. Countable/Uncountable nouns
Shopping phrases. Can I have…?/I would like…
What is it? (Bu nima?) Question words (What/Who/Where)
It is a book. (Bu kitob) Indefinite article (a/an)
Describing products 1. Adjectives (big, small, red, new)
Describing products 2. Adjective order (a big red bag)
Talking about things. This/That + be + adjective. Practice tests 2. Grammar: be going to & present continuous (for future)
Office and technology. Where is the office? 1. Prepositions of place (in, on, under, next to). Grammar: Prepositions of place (in, on, under, next to, opposite, near)
Where is the office? 2 Wh-questions (Where is…?). Grammar focus: Functional phrases for making and receiving calls (Can I speak to…? / I’m sorry, he isn’t here.)
On the phone 1. Polite requests (Can/May I…?). Grammar focus: Present Simple (I use… / I don’t use…)
On the phone 2. Present Continuous for actions now
Free time. My hobby. In my free time… 1. Simple Present tense (I play, I read)
In my free time… 2. Adverbs of frequency (always, usually, sometimes, never)
My Hobby. My hobby is swimming. 1. Gerunds (-ing form) as subject/object
My hobby is swimming. 2. Like/Love + verb+ing
Leisure activity. Agreements. My leisure activity. Can/Can’t (I can play football, I can’t swim). Grammar: Modals of probability (may, might, must, can’t)
With pleasure. (Taklif va rozi bo‘lish) Let’s… / Shall we…?
Sorry, I haven’t got time. Present Simple negative (I don’t have time). Practice tests 3
Eating. Invitation to the house. Do you like Uzbek national food? 1. Do/Does in questions
Uzbek meals. (Milliy taomlar) Countable/Uncountable food nouns. Grammar Focus: Present Simple Passive
Inviting home. (Uyga taklif qilish) Would you like to…?
Accepting invitation. Yes, I’d love to / That’s a good idea. Grammar: Reported Commands (e.g. The teacher told me to eat vegetables.)
Refusing invitation. I’m sorry, I can’t / Maybe next time
Travelling. Transportation (Sayohat qilish, transport vositalari) Part 1. Talking about travelling. Grammar: Present Simple (Do you like…?)
At the railway station. Grammar: Telling the time (What time is it?)
Using transportation. Grammar: Prepositions of transport (by bus, by car, on foot)
Travel experiences. Grammar: Past Simple (went, visited). Practice tests 4
My daily routine. Time (Mening kun tartibim. Vaqt) Part 1. Morning routine. Grammar: Present Simple (routines)
Part 2. Breakfast. Grammar: Countable & uncountable nouns (bread, tea, an egg)
Part 3. School time. Grammar: Prepositions of time (at, in, on)
Part 4. Afternoon activities. Grammar: Adverbs of frequency (always, often, sometimes)
Holidays. Seasons (Bayramlar. Fasllar) Part 1. National holidays. Grammar: Present Simple (is, celebrate)
Part 2. Favourite holidays. Grammar: Possessive adjectives (my, your, our)
Part 3. Seasons. Grammar: There is / There are
Part 4. Talking about weather. Grammar: Present Continuous for weather (It is snowing / raining)
Exam preparation Revision
Exam preparation. Practice tests 5
A1.Part 2 Jobs and family (Kasblar va oila) Talking about family. Grammar: To be (is / are)
Describing parents’ jobs. Grammar: Present Simple (works, teaches)
Talking about siblings. Grammar: Have got / Has got
Childhood memories. Grammar: Past Simple (played, went, was)
Talking about the future. Grammar: “Be going to” (future intentions)
Other professions (Teacher, Driver, Farmer, etc.) → Job vocabulary
My room (Mening xonam) 1. This is my bedroom → There is / There are
2. The wall is white → Adjectives + to be (The wall is blue). Practice tests 6
Tourism (Turizm) 1. Describing landscape → There is/are + Prepositions of place
2. Tourist attractions → Present Simple (People visit...). Grammar Focus: There was / There were
3. My holiday → Past Simple (I went, I saw, I visited). Grammar Focus: Indirect questions – “Can you tell me where…?”
4. Future travel plans → “Going to” (I am going to travel)
5. Comparing places → Comparatives & Superlatives (bigger, the most beautiful)
Buying things (Xarid qilish) 1. Asking for prices → How much is...? / How many...?
2. Shopping dialogues → Can I...? / I would like
3. Talking about quantities → Some/any, a lot of, much/many)
Sightseeing (Sayohat) 1. Skyscrapers in the city → There is/are + a lot of
2. Directions → Imperatives (Go straight, Turn left...)
3. Describing places → Adjectives (modern, beautiful, noisy). Practice tests 7
Culture (Madaniyat) 1. Every country has its culture → Possessive adjectives (its, our, their)
2. National traditions → Present Simple (People celebrate...)
3. Festivals & holidays → Past Simple (We celebrated...)
4. Food and customs → Like/Don’t like + ing
4. Food and customs → Like/Don’t like + ing
Sport. Fitness –1.My favourite sport → What is your favourite...?
2. Types of sports → Can for ability (I can swim)
3. Talking about frequency → Adverbs (always, usually, sometimes, never)
4. Health benefits of sport → Present Simple (Sport makes us healthy). Practice tests 8
Health and illness – 1. I have got a temperature → Have got / Has got
2. Talking about symptoms → Present Continuous (I am coughing)
3. Types of illness → Vocabulary (headache, flu, cold...)
4. Doctor-patient dialogue → Should/Shouldn’t (You should drink tea)
My workplace – 1. My workplace location → There is/are + Prepositions
2. Colleagues → Adjectives (friendly, helpful)
3. Job responsibilities → Present Simple (I work, I answer phones)
4. Office objects → This/That/These/Those
5. Talking about time → Prepositions of time (at, on, in). Practice tests 9
At the restaurant – 1. Ordering food → Can I...? / I would like
2. Bringing the bill → Imperatives (Bring..., Give...)
3. Food vocabulary → Countable/uncountable nouns (some water, an apple)
